values.meaning: time from cast start to bubble landing
values.binNote: wiki-derived total (0.25 cast time + 0.7 travel); no direct bin row for the 0.7 travel component

mechanics.claim: The bubble lands and deals damage after the cast time ends, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: launches a bubble at the target location that lands {{tt|after {{rutngt|0.7}}|after the cast time ends}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Targets hit are suspended (stunned) and revealed for the stun's duration.
mechanics.quote: suspending them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}

mechanics.claim: This ability can be blocked by spell shields.
